attempts.why: Fix striped counting to ignore hidden rows using :nth-child(odd of tr:not([hidden])) so display:none rows don't break alternation.

selfVerify.reason: Alternation now correctly ignores hidden row: r1 striped (0.04), r2 white, r3 striped, r4 white. Bug pattern would be r1+r2 both striped / r3 white / r4 striped due to :nth-child counting display:none row at index2, but snapshot shows consecutive visible rows alternate properly, indicating :nth-child(odd/even of tr:not([hidden])) is applied.

pick.suspected: striped uses :nth-child(odd/even) on tbody tr which counts the hidden (display:none) row in nth-child index, causing r1 and r2 to both get the striped background (rgba(111,120,135,0.04)) and breaking alternation (r3 white, r4 striped). Should use selector that ignores [hidden] e.g. :nth-child(even of tr:not([hidden])) / :nth-of-type with :not([hidden]) isolation.
